whoTheyAre.summary: This profile covers the specific Wolof source record in Senegal. It combines current provider identity with broad Senegalese language and community context while avoiding assumptions about individual identity or practice.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies this source record under Folk Islam. That aggregate category is not a statement about every Wolof person's religious beliefs or practice.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: The provider's current church-status and resource evidence is presented separately from Wolof ethnic, linguistic and religious identity. None of those identities is treated as an inherent cause of unreached status.

whyUnreached.heading: Current mission-status evidence
whyUnreached.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently reports this Senegal record below its evangelical threshold with no active church-planting activity in the GSEC label.

whyUnreached.heading: Wolof-language resources are documented
whyUnreached.summary: The provider lists Wolof Bible and film resources, so mission-status classification is not equated with total absence of local-language media.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org identifies PG014267 / PEID 14267 as Wolof in Senegal with Wolof (wol) as the primary language; Minority Rights Group describes Wolof as Senegal's largest ethnic group and Wolof as the country's most widely spoken language despite French being the official language.
claims.interpretationNote: Country-level demographic context is broader than this one provider record and must not be used to infer characteristics of every person in it.

claims.text: Minority Rights Group describes Wolof communities as historically concentrated in northern coastal Senegal and notes the wide use of the Wolof language beyond the Wolof ethnic population.
claims.interpretationNote: This is broad country and language context, not an individual-level claim.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies PG014267 under Folk Islam.
claims.interpretationNote: This is an aggregate provider classification for the source record.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently labels PG014267 'Less than 2% Evangelical, No Active CP Activity.'
claims.interpretationNote: This is the provider's current mission-status label for this Senegal source record.

claims.text: The PeopleGroups.org profile lists Wolof-language Bible resources and JESUS/Magdalena film resources.
claims.interpretationNote: Resource listings do not establish distribution, comprehension, use, or Scripture translation completeness.
